title: Policy and control decisions for technology systems
discussion_question: What policy guardrails should a technology company put in place before deploying fast-moving automation into critical internal and customer-facing workflows?
supplementary_materials: Address auditability, exception handling, review latency, downstream enforcement, operator burden, incentive design, and how policy should interact with the actual software delivery system rather than an idealized one.
output_contract: Respond in three short sections named policy stance, rationale, and implementation guardrails.
assumptions_and_constraints: Assume the organization faces real delivery pressure, cannot outsource judgment to boilerplate rules, and must keep controls legible to the teams expected to follow them.
